summary: Retest of iteration_7 CRITICAL identity/buy-button bug on /pro (web preview, 390x844). FIXED: after opening app anonymously then logging in via /login (tester@glitchradar.app), /pro shows no pro-identity-banner within 2.5s, pro-buy-button enabled, tap opens pro-confirm-modal ('TEST-KAUF BESTÄTIGEN', $49.99); pro-confirm-cancel closes it (no purchase made). After full page reload while logged in: same result (banner gone, button enabled, modal opens). Regression: logged out -> pro-login-banner visible, buy button aria-disabled=true and tapping it does not open modal; weekly/annual/monthly cards present, annual has 'Empfohlen' badge + 'Nur $4.16 / Monat', no lifetime card; pro-trial-banner visible ('noch 2 T 23 Std').
critical_code_review_comments: revenuecat.tsx: identityReady now derived from Purchases.getAppUserID() refreshed on customerInfo data/dataUpdatedAt; purchase guard uses Purchases.isAnonymous() - correct.

Minor: on web the SDK re-initializes with the anonymous id stored in localStorage (revenuecat_user_id) on every load and auth.tsx re-calls Purchases.logIn; works, but there is a brief window where identityReady is false on cold start (banner may flash). Acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Identity bug fixed and verified. Do NOT tap pro-confirm-ok (would simulate a real Test Store purchase on the tester account).
rca_of_issue: Previous RCA: customerInfo.originalAppUserId stays the first anonymous id after alias merge. Fix uses current app user id; verified working.
